audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Kennen 5 of 7 stages while Kled's win rate is 55.05%, the packet chart reads Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kennen/Kennen/Kled, and the already-audited mirror (kennen__kled) locked that exact chart. The page's own whys[1], whys[2], whys[3] and whys[6] all describe Kled winning those rows.
audit.why: Every layer of evidence — packet, mirror, win rate and the prose already on the page — pointed the same way, and only the side tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kennen, Kennen, Kled as matched pairs in both layers, ratings re-scaled 5/7/8/7/4/4/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why was untouched template text with no cooldowns; Slicing Maelstrom's timer never appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s — that is the length of the window after he spends it. Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s, Bear Trap free at 11s rank 1, Violent Tendencies 13s.
audit.corrected: The 120s R, the 10s Lightning Rush and the free 11s Bear Trap written into the phase rows, the cooldown block and the Do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly attributed the stun to Electrical Surge ('bait his W Electrical Surge stun', 'the instant his W stun is down'). Riot's text puts the stun on the passive, Mark of the Storm, after three marks; W only applies another mark.
audit.why: Telling the reader to wait out 'the W stun' teaches the wrong count — Q, W and E each apply a mark, and it is the third mark from any of them that stuns. Kled has no way to time that off one spell.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] and the interactions row rewritten around counting Mark of the Storm stacks; the triple-stun Don't body now matches its own title.
sources: kit file kennen P, Q, W, E

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] was titled 'Dodge his Q poke' but its body talked about wasting Lightning Rush.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken is a 950-range projectile on a 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s cooldown — it is dodgeable, and that is what the title promises.
audit.corrected: Body replaced with the sidestep instruction and the real range.

edits.before: Mounted stats bully every level-1 exchange. Identify how Kennen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Even: he chips Skaarl from 950 with Thundering Shuriken, but that bar is a buffer and any step-up loses to mounted autos.

edits.before: Q beartrap is the kill switch — land it and rip the combo. Only take the trade when Kennen's Lightning Rush is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap is free on an 11s cooldown — land it and rip the combo the moment his third Mark of the Storm is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kennen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit at 3: E in, W the four shots, re-E out. His squishy ranged frame has no remount and cannot survive that burst.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Lightning Rush's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Short trades every 13s on Violent Tendencies: remount sustain out-heals his Q/W chip while his only out is Lightning Rush move speed.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kennen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom (120s) is a moving multi-stun through Mark of the Storm — never dive a fresh R without Flash up.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kennen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He never buys bulk — your percent-HP Q and remount reclaim the duel whenever you close the gap. Kennen carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: He out-pokes you level 1 with Q shuriken and W marks while you have no spammable answer — preserve Skaarl's health and last-hit at range.
edits.after: He pokes with Thundering Shuriken from 950 but Skaarl's bar absorbs it, and one bad step-up dies to your mounted autos — last-hit at range.

edits.before: Bait his W Electrical Surge stun and E in the moment it's down, then Q-pull to stick and W-shred his squishy body
edits.after: Count his Mark of the Storm stacks — the third one stuns, so E in at zero marks, then Q-pull to stick and W-shred

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. Q-pull when it’s down. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you — the third mark, not any one spell, is what you count before you commit.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Q-pull when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — his escape, 10s at rank 1. Q-pull the moment it is spent. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s flat — his one window on you. - Your Bear Trap: free, 11s — never spend it on the wave.

edits.before: His escape. Q-pull when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His escape on a 10s cooldown at rank 1 — Q-pull the moment he spends it.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken is a 950-range projectile — sidestep it, don't tank it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm chain into a stun — count them before you go.
